openings.claim: Immutable input receipts may prevent unintended-version downloads through input binding and clearer identification.
openings.discriminator: Correct selection with mismatched hashes implicates binding; unchanged selection errors weaken identification sufficiency.
openings.probe: Privately replay interleaved cuts/revisions with reversed completion. Counterbalance receipts versus completion numbers at identical timings; show excerpts/request identities; verify actual input hashes and selection time/errors.
openings.uncertainty: Out-of-order completion is not a proven cause; displayed labels alone cannot verify associations.

openings.claim: Separate render waiting from choosing/reviewing an available intended preview.
openings.discriminator: Late intended-output availability supports waiting; early availability followed by comparison/errors supports identification overhead; both may contribute.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints if sharing bounded editor exercise.
openings.probe: Align render events with final edit, intended-output availability, selections and correct identification; compare repeated edits with single corrections.
openings.uncertainty: Nine successful single-correction sessions support incumbent viability; dominant delay and festival capacity remain unknown.

openings.claim: A private synchronized overlay might replace some preview renders if it predicts embedded wording/timing.
openings.discriminator: Any cue disagreement falsifies equivalence for that tested case.
openings.probe: Test one supported caption case on demonstration footage; two editors compare overlay/embedder cue boundaries and one correction; record disagreement, usable latency and resource use.
openings.uncertainty: Requires immutable pairs, aligned parsing/timing and accurate browser playback; broader equivalence remains speculative.

lineage.reason: With Z1; preserves controlled identification comparison.

decision: Prioritize shared D1/D2 diagnosis; D3 is exploratory. Keep all assets/computation private, embedded final format and last-delivered original captions accessible. Bound combined work to four engineer-days, one editor-day and 80 processing hours/week. Synthetic staging cannot establish the 30-session success target.
